shots.text: The Thunder Steppe is grassland on a high plateau. The Galeborn live there on horseback and steer by the storms. Its Warden, Aurath, sleeps in the storms themselves.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Endless high grass under a racing sky, standing stones, tent-cities, riders on grey horses.

shots.text: Aurath had gone mad, and the storms turned on the camps they used to guide. Lightning struck the tents. Dead riders came back on horses of lightning. Over them, on a bird of black cloud, rode the Herald Vholt Stormcrown, the warchief who had taught half the Steppe to ride.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Lightning striking a burning tent camp. Dead riders on lightning-maned horses charging through the grass, harpies and balls of lightning over them. Above, on a thunderbird of black cloud, an old warchief with a crown of lightning: Vholt.

shots.text:
The Galeborn don't build walls. Your towers are the only walls they've got. And lightning doesn't hurt lightning. Build stone. It grounds the stuff.

Start at Stonering Camp.
shots.speaker: fennick
shots.art_note: Fennick on horseback, badly, holding his hat on, pointing at a camp of standing stones.
